sourcing: Every price, SKU, option list and image below was pulled from the brand's own public Shopify feed on 2026-09-26. Products the user listed that could not be verified (blocked sites, or names that do not exist as listed) were replaced with a same-type product from a brand feed that answers, and each replacement is named in the notes.

products.name: K&H Original Pet Cot
products.size: Small 17 x 22 in to X-Large 32 x 50 in
products.description: K&H's classic raised pet cot, sold from Small 17 x 22 in through X-Large 32 x 50 in with green, charcoal or chocolate covers. A simple off-the-floor perch for cats and small dogs that keeps them off cold tiles and draughts, and it folds down for storage.
products.image_alt: K&H Original Pet Cot raised bed in chocolate with black trim
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Chocolate/Black / Small 17” X 22” X 7”', USD 24.95, store SKU 100212972. Store options: Green/Black; Medium 25” X 32” X 7”; Large 30” X 42” X 7”; X-Large 32” X 50” X 9”; Charcoal/Black; Jumbo 56" X 38" X 9"; Small 17” X 22” X 7”; Navy/Black. Full store price range 24.95-64.98. Kept exactly as the user listed it.

products.name: K&H Self-Warming Nuzzle Nest Pet Bed
products.description: A self-warming pet bed from K&H that works off the animal's own body heat, so it needs no power. The deep nuzzle-nest shape gives a dog or cat a curled, den-like place to settle, which makes it a practical cold-weather addition indoors.
products.image_alt: K&H Self-Warming Nuzzle Nest Pet Bed, round self-warming pet bed
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 34.98, store SKU 100213086. User listed 'K&H Self-Warming Pet Bed'; this Nuzzle Nest is the self-warming pet bed the K&H feed publishes.

products.name: K&H Original Bolster Pet Cot
products.size: Small 17 x 22 in to Large 30 x 42 in
products.description: A raised cot with padded bolsters along three sides, so a dog can rest its head without rolling off. K&H lists it from Small 17 x 22 in to Large 30 x 42 in in chocolate or charcoal, giving a boxed-in feel that suits nervous or older dogs.
products.image_alt: K&H Original Bolster Pet Cot in chocolate with raised padded sides
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Small 17" x 22" x 7" / Chocolate', USD 44.95, store SKU 100213497. Store options: Large 30" x 42" x 7"; Charcoal; Chocolate; Medium 25" x 32" x 7"; Small 17" x 22" x 7". Full store price range 44.95-84.98. Substitute for PetFusion Ultimate Dog Bed; petfusion.com answers 403 from this host.

products.name: K&H All Season All Weather Dog Cot
products.size: Medium 32 x 25 in to Jumbo 56 x 38 in
products.description: An outdoor-style raised cot for dogs, sized from Medium 32 x 25 in up to Jumbo 56 x 38 in in tan, gray or green. The open frame suits decks, kennels and patios, giving a dog a dry raised spot to lie in sun or shade.
products.image_alt: K&H All Season All Weather Dog Cot in gray, raised outdoor dog bed
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Medium 32 X 25 X 7 / Gray', USD 34.95, store SKU 100213623. Store options: Jumbo 56 X 38 X 9; Tan; Gray; X-Large 50 X 32 X 9; Green; Large 42 X 30 X 7; Medium 32 X 25 X 7. Full store price range 34.95-64.98. Substitute for Bedsure Waterproof Dog Bed; bedsure.com does not resolve from this host, and this is the all-weather/outdoor equivalent.

products.name: K&H Thermo Pet Cuddler Indoor Heated Donut Cat Bed
products.description: A heated donut-style bed for indoor cats, with a raised rim that keeps a curled body tucked in. The Thermo Pet Cuddler is listed as a single indoor model, aimed at cats that look for a warm enclosed spot in the cooler months.
products.image_alt: K&H Thermo Pet Cuddler heated donut cat bed with raised rim
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 69.98, store SKU 100553013. Substitute for FurHaven Plush Donut Pet Bed; furchaven.com does not resolve from this host. Same donut bed type.

products.name: Petsfit Large Cat Hammock Bed
products.description: A large cat hammock bed from Petsfit, hung so a cat can curl up off the floor. The suspended fabric pocket suits indoor cats that like height and a tucked-in resting spot.
products.image_alt: Petsfit large cat hammock bed with a cat curled up inside
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 59.99, store SKU DBW1035ZB00J. Added for cat bed variety; the two FurHaven cat bed slots were unreachable (furchaven.com does not resolve from this host).
